qualification.details: Eligibility differs for each post. Key requirements include: | Public Health Nurse/Rehabilitation Nurse (PHN-01): BSc. (Hons) Nursing from a recognized institute/university with 2 years of relevant experience. Statistician (STAT-02): Master's degree in statistics with familiarity in standard electronic statistical software; 2 years of health statistics experience is desirable. Occupational Therapist (OT-03): 10+2 in science (PCB) plus a Bachelor's degree in Occupational Therapy with 2 years of experience. Prosthetic and Orthotic Tech (POT-04): Bachelor's degree in Orthotics and Prosthetics, or a diploma in the same field with 2 years of workshop experience. Speech Therapist (ST-05) and Audiometry Technician (AT-06): BSc in Speech and Hearing; an MSc and clinical hospital experience are desirable. Health Educator (HE-07): Bachelor's degree in Botany/Zoology/Home Science/Nutrition/Chemistry/Social Science/Social Anthropology plus a Diploma in Health Education. Library Assistant (LA-08): Bachelor's degree in Library Science/Information Science; a one-year diploma in Computer Application is desirable. Store Keeper Cum Clerk Cum Computer Operator (SKCO-09): Class XII pass with a one-year diploma in Computer Application; a six-month diploma in Material/Store Management is desirable. Stenographer Cum Computer Operator (SCCC-10): Class XII pass, one-year diploma in Computer Application, and shorthand speed of 80 wpm with typing speed of 40 wpm. Dental Technician (DT-11): 10+2 with science, a minimum two-year diploma in Dental Hygiene/Dental Mechanic/Maxillo-facial Prosthesis and Orthodontic Appliances, and registration with the Dental Council of India. L.G. Clerk (LGC-12): Class XII pass with a typing speed of 35 wpm in English; computer education is desirable. Laboratory Attendant (LAB-13): Class XII (Science) pass with a Diploma in Medical Lab Technology; 2 years of relevant experience is desirable. Medical Record Officer (MRO-14): Bachelor's degree (preferably in science), a one-year course in Medical Records, and at least 5 years of experience managing records in a hospital of 200+ beds. Technician - Audio Visual (AVT-15): Class XII pass with a 3-year diploma in ECE/EEE (or a 2-year ITI trade certificate in electronics) and 2 years of experience handling AV equipment; must qualify a written exam conducted by the recruiting agency. Receptionist (RCP-16): Class XII pass with a one-year diploma in Public Relations/Hotel Management; 2 years of receptionist experience in a reputed institution is desirable.

content_sections.heading: ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS), Sri Vijaya Puram has officially released the Recruitment Notification 2026 for the engagement of 43 candidates across various posts. The recruitment includes vacancies for Public Health Nurse/Rehabilitation Nurse, Statistician, Occupational Therapist, Prosthetic and Orthotic Tech, Speech Therapist, Audiometry Technician, Health Educator, Library Assistant, Store Keeper Cum Clerk Cum Computer Operator, Stenographer Cum Computer Operator, Dental Technician, L.G. Clerk, Laboratory Attendant, Medical Record Officer, Technician (Audio Visual), and Receptionist. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official ANIIMS website: https://aniims.andamannicobar.gov.in Go to the "Candidate Corner" section. Select the relevant post you wish to apply for. Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, and contact information accurately. Upload the required documents/certificates in the prescribed format. Submit the application before the last date. Note down the Application Number generated after submission, required along with the registered mobile number to check application status. Important: Applications submitted offline (post, speed post, courier, etc.) will not be accepted. Only online applications through the official website are valid.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ANIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the ANIIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ANIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 43 vacancies announced for various posts in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 38 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for ANIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the ANIIMS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 typically includes a Written Exam, Skill Test, and Interview. Candidates must qualify in all stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment drive by ANIIMS is Contractual. Selected candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. Which educational qualifications are required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary significantly depending on the post, ranging from XII pass with specific diplomas to Bachelor's and Master's degrees in relevant fields like Nursing, Statistics, and Health Sciences.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates ranges from Rs. 18000 to Rs. 44900 per month, depending on the specific post and its pay scale.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or from the official website of ANIIMS.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the ANIIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of ANIIMS or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section, on or before the last date of application.
